verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never shows GitHub Projects acting as an MCP client that can plug in external MCP servers and use their tools. The official github-mcp-server is the server role, exposing GitHub to other agents, which is a different story. Assigning issues to Copilot is an adjacent AI feature, not MCP client support, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
